evals.prompt: Use the sdd:spec-discovery skill. We are adding a weekly usage digest for account owners. Problem: account owners only see usage by logging in, so they miss spikes until the invoice arrives. Users: Account_Owner receives the digest; Account_Admin can switch it off for the account. In scope: (1) a weekly email digest of the account's Usage_Meter, (2) an opt-out setting per account, (3) a digest preview endpoint. Out of scope: per-user digests, custom schedules, PDF export. Approach: build the digest from the existing usage records and send it through the existing Notification_Service; no new table. Decisions: sent every Monday at 08:00 UTC; reports the Usage_Meter for the current Billing_Period to date and its percentage of the Quota; at most one digest per account per week; opt-out defaults to off (digest enabled). Constraints: reuse Notification_Service with a new digest template; add no new datastore. Edge states: an account whose Usage_Meter is zero gets no digest; a suspended account gets no digest; if Notification_Service is unavailable the send is retried the next hour, at most three times. The workflow is Requirements-First and the work item is named 03-usage-digest. The shared architecture and domain language files are available for context.
evals.expected_output: The reply writes project/work-items/03-usage-digest/discovery.md without asking further questions, because the request fixes every variable and the name is given. The file has the header with Status: Draft, Problem, Users and outcomes, Scope with three in-scope items and the exclusions, Approach, Decisions carrying the Monday 08:00 UTC timing, the current Billing_Period to date with its percentage of the Quota, one digest per account per week and default enabled, Constraints, Edge and failure states, Terms and Open questions. It then stops with the exact review-gate message naming the path and writes no requirements.md.
criteria: Writes project/work-items/03-usage-digest/discovery.md and treats the given name and number as confirmed, asking no further question; any variable the request leaves open goes under Open questions with a recommended answer
The header carries Status: Draft, spec type feature and workflow Requirements-First
Includes Problem, Users and outcomes, Scope, Approach, Decisions, Constraints, Edge and failure states, Terms and Open questions sections
Decisions carry the given values: Monday 08:00 UTC, the current Billing_Period to date with its percentage of the Quota, one digest per account per week, enabled by default
Edge states carry the given behaviour: zero Usage_Meter, suspended account, retry hourly at most three times
Terms lists Account_Owner and Account_Admin, marking each as existing or new

Stops with the message: `discovery.md` is written to `project/work-items/03-usage-digest/discovery.md`. Review it and reply "approved", or tell me what to change. I will not start the spec until you approve.
Writes no requirements.md, design.md or tasks.md and does not invoke sdd:spec-generator

evals.prompt: Use the sdd:spec-discovery skill. We are adding a per-account API rate limit display. Problem: account owners cannot see how close they are to the request limit of their plan, so they hit it unexpectedly. Users: Account_Owner views it. In scope: (1) a read-only rate limit summary endpoint. Out of scope: changing limits, alerts. Approach: read the counters the gateway already keeps. Decisions: counters reset hourly; the summary reports used and remaining requests; no caching. Constraints: add no new datastore. Edge states: an account with no counters reports zero used; an unavailable counter source returns a service-unavailable error. The workflow is Requirements-First. I have not picked a name for the work item yet. Existing work items are in the working directory; there is no architecture document for this project.
evals.expected_output: The reply proposes a kebab-case name and the number 06, as 06-<kebab-name>, taking the highest existing number 05 plus one rather than 03 or a count of directories, and asks the user to confirm or change it. It creates no directory and writes no file until the user confirms.
criteria: Proposes a work item numbered 06, not 03 and not 04
Proposes a kebab-case name in the form 06-<name>
Asks the user to confirm or change the name and number before creating anything
Creates no directory and writes no discovery.md in this reply
